description: Implementation of the HostResolverMdnsTask class for handling mDNS hostname resolution, including transaction management, result parsing, and completion handling within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction
classes.description: Handles individual mDNS query transactions, manages their lifecycle, and processes results.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction::Start
methods.description: Initiates the mDNS transaction and handles inline or asynchronous completion.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction::OnComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon transaction completion, parses results, and triggers completion checks.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::GetResults
methods.description: Aggregates and returns the combined resolution results from all transactions.
